create_COCOEvaluatorMemoryEfficient: create a COCOEvaluatorMemoryEfficient instance to evaluate detection and segmentation predictions on a dataset
run_COCOEvaluatorMemoryEfficient_evaluat: run COCOEvaluatorMemoryEfficient evaluate method to compute AP and AR metrics from accumulated predictions
build_instances_to_coco_json: build COCO-format JSON from Instances objects for a given image ID
test_evaluate_predictions_on_coco: test COCO predictions using COCOEval API with configurable iou type and max detections
review_COCOevalMaxDets: review COCOevalMaxDets class that computes AP with custom maxDets limit instead of default 100
